static_traits.name: Lin Sha
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友和家人可谈Average问题,但not yet与他们讨论这些具体感受
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet有类似心理问题;not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询;without重要躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,能识do not并报告'应该'句式与自我比较;自我批评较多;语速与逻辑Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 对自我持续not满,反复出现'我应该更大更大胆,not能只是普通的美国青年'的念头;与他人比较使压力加重,影响自尊与整体幸福感.
basic_info.core_demands: 因为持续的压力与对自我的not满影响日常生活与Interpersonal relationships而寻求咨询支持.
growth_experiences: 今年夏天陷入恋爱后开始出现强烈的自我not满意与'应该变得更成功,更外向,更令人印象深刻'的压力;此后几乎每日在看到他人取得成就或冒险时被trigger,逐渐影响Learning成绩,Interpersonal relationships与心情.
长期在社交媒体上与他人进行比较:他人似乎拥有'精彩生活',由此Reinforcement'自己只是普通,not够好'的感受,增加压力与自我批评.

special_situations.event: After falling in love this summer, facing expectations and self-demands in the intimate relationship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我只是普通,not是更成功或更外向,就not配得到喜欢与认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces myself to step out of my comfort zone, trying to become bolder and more extroverted to prove my value
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更成功,更大胆,not能只是普通

special_situations.event: Whenever seeing others achieve great accomplishments or take bold adventures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not比同龄人更出色,就等于落后和失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently compares with others, pressures oneself to demand higher performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们,我应该做得更多

special_situations.event: Browsing social media, seeing others' seemingly wonderful life and achievement displays
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的生活not像他们那样精彩,就说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing social media browsing and self-evaluation, ignoring one's own positive side
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is doing better than me; I am so mediocre

special_situations.event: When trying to affirm her own strengths (kindness, supporting family and friends)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有卓越与成就才算价值,善良等优点'not算数'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或贬低自身积极品质,继续自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些优点not够,我仍然not够好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be loved and recognized; hopes to be more 'outstanding'
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为平庸而被忽视或not被爱
defense_goal: 通过自我苛责与not断比较来维持控制感和价值感
以更高标准约束自己以避免Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: 普通且not够好的自我,需要not断提升以证明价值
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the world are picky judges who only approve of more successful, more outgoing people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing others achieve success or display a wonderful life in reality or on social media
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为自己明显not如他人,若not变得更优秀就会被忽视或not被爱
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和,Empathy的语气回应其自责,帮助识do not比较—自我价值的混淆,邀请具体化当下体验,避免评判.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited by others or the counselor to affirm her own strengths and practice self-acceptance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把'善良/支持家人'视为not够重要,认为只有更成功,更大胆才配得认可
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a curious and supportive tone, gently restating her logic and guiding the identification of value conditions and emotional needs, encouraging lingering in the present feelings.

Distances from family and friends in real relationships due to self-blame

antecedent: Seeing others achieve or take bold risks
Browsing the 'wonderful lives' on social media
Faces intimate-relationship expectations and self-demands after falling in love

target_behavior.function: Seeks external recognition and avoids being seen as mediocre or ignored
